crop.notes: Whole item with headline 'Preparing for the Battle.'

ocr.notes: Drops 'in May next' after 'near New Orleans'; 'traing' in image is a misprint for training.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen was going into training at the Wash House, under Jack Gelding, for his $5,000-a-side fight with Jem Mace near New Orleans in May.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, March 29, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen went into training at the Wash House, under Jack Gelding, for his fight with Jem Mace near New Orleans in May for $5,000 a side
